answer.answer: The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure is a central sector scheme [E01] that aims to familiarize willing and eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and graduates pursuing post-graduation or research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Government [E01]. The internship is neither a job nor any assurance for a job in the Department of Expenditure [E01]. The duration ranges from two to six months at different points during the financial year [E01]. Interns receive token remuneration of ₹10,000 per month, payable upon satisfactory completion and submission of their report/paper [E01]. They are provided with office space and a computer with internet facility [E01], and are attached with DS/Director level officers in different divisions based on their areas of interest [E01]. Interns must furnish a declaration of secrecy before reporting [E01] and are required to present a report/paper on their allotted subject at the end of the internship [E02]. Certificates are issued upon satisfactory completion and submission of the report/paper [E01].
